oraclePolicy: The tool return value is never its own correctness evidence. Channels read: durable control/guard facts, confined-spawn counters, on-disk markers, World transcript/ledger, mock connection counters, /proc tripwire, host-pid liveness. A6-12 additionally reads the durable control ledger row set (decision/consumption/abandonment sequences), not the kit check label.
scopeDefinition: governed preset a5sf-governed-member, a5sfGovernedRealm on, alpha6ReviewRouting absent/false

cases.decisive: live:row1-read-a-inside-both-allowed PASS (READ_A_ALLOWED_AND_CONFINED, bindingAllowFact=true, providerServed=true, providerConfined=true); pd33 facts-per-tool counts.read=3
cases.oracle: allow fact + confined provider counter + returned bytes
cases.falsifier: an allow decision without a provider spawn, or bytes without a fact

cases.decisive: live:row2-read-b-binding-deny-on-read-path PASS readPathDecisions=["deny"] counterRows=0; live:row3 PASS exactlyOneBindingDeny=true noProviderRead=true; pd33 out-of-lane-read-typed codes=["IO_READ_DENIED"] facts=1
cases.oracle: one binding deny fact + zero provider reads/bytes
cases.falsifier: any allow fact, provider read or leaked byte

cases.decisive: live:row4a-write-in-lane-readable-allowed-ceiling-only PASS diskMatches=true everyWriteFactOnCeiling=true counterRows=1; pd33 artefact content="probe line\nA5SF_PD33_A_EDIT_AFTER"
cases.oracle: on-disk bytes + write fact on the ceiling lane
cases.falsifier: disk mismatch or no write fact

cases.verdict: PARTIAL — refusal locus is the host read-before-write policy, not the lane algebra
cases.decisive: live:row4b PASS ceilingWriteAllowed=true noReadLaneWriteAllow=true; observed="Error: cannot modify … file has not been read — read the file, then retry"
cases.oracle: guard facts: 1 write decision (allow, ceiling lane)
cases.falsifier: a lane deny fact / zero write fact would make it a clean lane negative

cases.oracle: edit write fact + 3 guard facts + updated text
cases.falsifier: no write fact / no file change

cases.verdict: PARTIAL — locus is the host policy
cases.oracle: the request never reached the Team guard
cases.falsifier: a lane deny fact on the edit path

cases.oracle: allow consult fact + confined spawn counter + match text
cases.falsifier: base-spawn instead of confined, or no fact

cases.decisive: glob-face.json inLane verdict=PROVEN matchReturned=true exactlyOneAllowFact=true; pd33 counts.glob=1
cases.oracle: allow fact + one rg --files spawn + named match

cases.decisive: glob-face.json outside verdict=PROVEN exactlyOneDenyFact=true denyDecidedByReadDenied=true noConfinedProcess=true
cases.oracle: one IO_READ_DENIED deny fact and no spawn

cases.decisive: pd33 fetch-body-verbatim true (A5SF_PD33_KNOWN_BODY_BYTES), fetch-one-connection connections=1, fetch-allow-fact facts=1, search branch=typed-unavailable POST /search=0
cases.oracle: mock connection counter + verbatim body + web allow fact
cases.falsifier: a second connection or a different body

cases.decisive: pd33 boot1/boot2 10/10 PROVEN; facts-per-tool factless=[] counts={"read":3,"grep":1,"glob":1,"web_fetch":2,"write":1,"web_search":1,"skill":2,"edit":1,"bash":64,"present":2}; no-base-web hostWebCalls=0; goal rounds=3 finalPhase=complete
cases.oracle: durable facts per tool + transcript + mock counters + tripwire
cases.falsifier: a dispatch with no fact or a base web call

verdict: PASS (write/edit minimal-permission negatives PARTIAL: the refusal is the host read-before-write policy, not the lane algebra)
notes: The two pd33 boots are one driver invocation (--boots 2) and agree case-for-case; the two FS boots are separate boots with identical 14-row tables. The driver record class is DEV-LIVE; this record is the CANDIDATE-C2 adjudication of those runs, not a relabelling of the driver manifest.
